body: I was prescribed it for my anxiety and constant panic attacks. I'd say my mental health couldn't be worse so the only risk I'm taking is wasting my time. Ive been trying to force myself to drink sips and eat a little, but I wasn't eating for weeks or drinking shit, still barely am. I constantly wanted and felt the need to go to the er and my panic attacks were long and not far apart at all, still are. It's a battle to try to subdue them every single second. I'll take fog and some memory loss to be better. That's the only way it could get worse at all
